column1: # Vietnamese (vi) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the PdfCraft English source label
# using ordinary Vietnamese computing and document vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource,
# string table or product UI (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Translation memory came only from PhotoCraft's and VectorCraft's Vietnamese catalogs, and an entry
# was reused only where the English source and its meaning in context matched. Product and technology
# names (PdfCraft, ArtCraft, PDF, Acrobat, JavaScript, OCR, XFA, AES, RSA, SHA …) stay as they are;
# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
# Plural rule: Vietnamese does not inflect for number (`plural_none` in i18n/mod.rs), so every
# @plural row lists exactly ONE form (no "|").
# Glossary (locked): File Tệp · Edit (menu) Chỉnh sửa, (comment menu) Sửa · Save Lưu · Save as…
# Lưu thành… · Undo Hoàn tác · Redo Làm lại · Cut Cắt · Copy Sao chép · Paste Dán · Delete Xóa ·
# Cancel Hủy · Close Đóng · Open… Mở… · Print… In… · Preferences Tùy chọn · Help Trợ giúp · View Xem ·
# Pages/Page Trang · Document Tài liệu · Bookmark Dấu trang · Comment Bình luận · Signature Chữ ký ·
# Form Biểu mẫu · Field (form field) Ô · Search/Find Tìm · Interface language Ngôn ngữ giao diện ·
# Appearance (theme) Giao diện, (object/field visuals) Diện mạo · Type (signature pad) Nhập chữ,
# (plain noun) Loại · Start (action wizard) Bắt đầu · Subject (certificate) Chủ thể chứng chỉ,
# (document topic) Chủ đề · Fill & Sign Điền & Ký · Folder Thư mục · Tools Công cụ.
# Months: standalone "Tháng Một" …; in the "calendar date" context lowercase "tháng Một" …
# ("{month} {day}, {y}" is reordered to "{day} {month}, {y}", the Vietnamese order).
# Weekdays (calendar weekday): CN T2 T3 T4 T5 T6 T7 (Sunday … Saturday).
# VI_KEEP_AS_IS (the translation is deliberately identical to the English source):
#   OK                              the universal dialog button
#   Digital ID                      Acrobat-compatible product term, used as a name
#   ZIP                             file-format name
#   JavaScript                      language name
#   Microsoft Word (.docx)          product + file format
#   PDF/A…                          standard name (trailing … kept)
#   PostScript / EPS                format names
#   Rich Text Format (.rtf)         format name
#   CheckBox, Combo, PushButton, Radio   PDF form field type identifiers (as in the PDF spec/JS API)
#   Standard Business               name of a built-in stamp
#   Home / End                      pair of key names shown together
#   English                         the language's own name in the language picker
#   {0}: {1}   {field}: {e}   {month} {y}   {n} {kind}   {rule} - {status}   `{command}` {when}
#                                   pure placeholder templates with nothing to translate
#   +LOC  −LOC  ΔLOC  +Bin  −Bin    contributor-table column symbols
#   Keychain  ·                     macOS Keychain prefix (product name)
#   key context: Ctrl, Shift, Delete, Esc, Home, End, Space
#                                   Windows-style key caps that are universal
